'''Nabicci Futana''' was a [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who had composed a number of [[Neoclassical period|Neoclassical]] [[Waltz/Legends|waltzes]] and [[ganther dance]]s<ref name="Adventure Journal 5" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}} dates the announcement of the ISO's Mid Rim tour to 35:10:16 in the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, which corresponds to seven [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] or [[0 ABY]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] scheduled to perform several of Futana's waltzes and ganther dances while on its [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] tour.<ref name="Adventure Journal 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nabicci Futana was mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" article written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]<ref name="Adventure Journal 5" />
